Almost! The issue: the ProtocolError raised inside apply_frame doesn't carry the frame index. I need to set the frame index when catching the error in apply_frames. Let me fix: in the except block, use `error.frame if error.frame is not None else position`.

p='entry.py'; s=open(p).read()
old = """            except ProtocolError as error:
                for action in reversed(undo):
                    action()
                self.fail(event, packet_index, error.frame, error.code, now)
                return"""
new = """            except ProtocolError as error:
                for action in reversed(undo):
                    action()
                offending = error.frame if error.frame is not None else position
                self.fail(event, packet_index, offending, error.code, now)
                return"""

s = s.replace(old, new)
